card.name: Stability study wording in storage sections
card.fires_on: The word right after "Stability" (studies, testing, indicating) in reconstituted-solution stability passages. It also fires on the degree sign after a storage temperature number.

modes.label: After Stability
modes.description: A noun or verb right after the word Stability, introducing stability data for diluted or reconstituted drug.
modes.example: Stability<< studies>> of daptomycin for injection solutions

modes.label: Storage temperature
modes.description: The degree unit or word "temperature" in storage conditions for prepared solutions.
modes.example: 16 weeks at 40<<°C>> Sterile Diluents for Trepro

card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says stability studies were done or gives the storage temperature of a prepared solution.
